_about: Copy for the home page (start.html), rendered by scripts/make-marketing-pages.mjs. The shape (30 Oct 2026, conversion pass): a pain-led hero with the OFFER CARD beside it (the launch pass while it is open, else the founding price, else nothing), the four-card scroll story, a value stack, three points on keeping your work, the plans teaser, a short FAQ and a closing offer band. Every claim is checkable in this repo. NO price, date, count or length is typed in the offer copy: each is a runtime slot filled from trial_offer() / price_notice(). A build figure is a {{fms:...}} stamp (dragon.*, price.from.day) filled by the fms-start-figures plugin in vite.config.js, never typed. {plan} is the offered plan's name, stamped by the generator.

items.title: Saved in your browser
items.text: Every keystroke is written to this device first. Sync to your other devices is yours to switch off.

items.title: Works without a signal
items.text: Install it like an app. It works on set offline for up to 14 days after you last signed in on that device.

items.title: Backed up your way
items.text: Download a backup of every project whenever you like, and restore it from the same menu.

plans.teaser: A year of the studio from about {{fms:price.from.day}} a day. Breakdown, scheduling and call sheets are part of the plans, not add-ons.

faq._: At most six questions, answered only with facts already true in this repo. The year-end answer is an EMPTY offer-terms slot (offer-terms.js fills it) beside a neutral line; the trial clause shows only while trial_offer() reports one open and no pass is running. Never say "free trial".

items.a: Your work is saved in your own browser first. Sync to your other devices is optional, and yours to switch off.

items.q: Does it work offline and on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Install it like an app on a phone or a computer. The shoot day view is built for a phone on set, and your work is on the device, so it keeps working without a signal.

items.q: What happens when the year ends?
items.a: A plan runs for a year from the day you buy it. Its terms are shown on the plans page and at checkout, before you pay.

Purchases are final, with three exceptions that are not discretionary: a duplicate or erroneous charge, a payment for a plan that was never activated on your account, and any refund the law of India requires.

items.q: Do I pay in rupees or dollars?
items.a: In India you pay in rupees. Elsewhere, prices are shown in US dollars where they are available, and the rupee amount Razorpay charges is always shown before you pay.

items.q: Can I see it before I pay?
items.a: Yes. Each stage above shows the tool working on the sample feature, and the plans page compares every feature.
items.trial: While trials are open, the page after you continue with Google offers one before you buy.

closing.h2: Open the studio and write scene one
closing.sub: Continue with Google to start. Every tool reads the same scenes.
